meta.name: task-coordination-strategies
meta.description: Decompose complex tasks, design dependency graphs, and coordinate multi-agent work with proper task descriptions and workload balancing. Use this skill when breaking down work for agent teams, managing task dependencies, or monitoring team progress.

copy.tagline: 拆解复杂任务，协调多个代理高效执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要带领多个 AI 代理一起完成复杂任务
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex tasks and coordinate multiple agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to lead multiple AI agents to finish complex tasks together

howto.what: Claude 会将复杂任务拆成可并行的小任务,设计依赖图(如 blockedBy),写出含目标、验收标准和范围边界的任务描述,并监控团队成员负载,发现不平衡时提供重新分配步骤。
howto.when: 当你要求为代理团队拆分工作、管理任务依赖,或监控团队进度时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个全栈功能按层拆成并行任务,并画出依赖图。
say.note: Claude 会产出拆分方案和任务依赖关系。

say.text: 为这些任务添加 blockedBy 依赖,标出关键路径。
say.note: Claude 会给出依赖图并指出最长链路。

say.text: 检查任务列表,找出过载成员并重新分配工作。
say.note: Claude 会调用 TaskList 并建议调整。

howto.what_en: Claude will decompose complex tasks into parallelizable units, design dependency graphs (e.g., blockedBy), write task descriptions with objectives, acceptance criteria, and scope boundaries, and monitor team workload, offering rebalancing steps when imbalances are found.
howto.when_en: When you ask to break down work for agent teams, manage task dependencies, or monitor team progress.

say_en.text: Break this full-stack feature into parallel tasks by layer and draw a dependency graph.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a breakdown and dependency relationships.

say_en.text: Add blockedBy dependencies to these tasks and identify the critical path.
say_en.note: Claude will output a dependency graph and longest chain.

say_en.text: Review the task list, find overloaded members, and rebalance the work.
say_en.note: Claude will call TaskList and suggest reassignments.
